tasks.title: Business logo on the PDF
tasks.notes: Delivers PRD FR-SET-1, FR-SET-5 and FR-PDF-2, which had been specified but never built. The image is a BLOB in the new business_logo table (id, bytes, mime) rather than a file on disk, so the existing VACUUM INTO backups already carry it and no asset-protocol filesystem scope is needed; the PRD's logo_path column was dropped for that reason. Uploaded from Settings > Business through the dialog plugin, PNG or JPEG only, at most 2 MB and 4096px a side, checked on upload with printpdf's embedded_images decoder. The letterhead draws it above the business name in all three templates, with a placeholder until one is set and a fall back to the placeholder if a stored image will not decode. The MCP server is untouched: the bytes never enter the Business record.

tasks.title: UI & PDF localization
tasks.notes: Bahasa Indonesia, complete. The i18n core (src/lib/i18n.svelte.ts plus locales/en.ts and id.ts, type-checked for key parity) covers the shell and nav, every shared component, the reminder email, and every route: dashboard, invoices, estimates, clients, catalog, reports and all settings pages plus the document editors. Money, dates and month labels follow the UI language; Settings > Appearance switches ui.locale. Deliberately untranslated: the language endonyms, brand and template names, and example placeholders (INV-, Net 30, USD). The PDF has a separate document language (pdf.locale, chosen in Settings > Invoicing): pdf/labels.rs gained an ID table and Locale::parse now accepts id, ID and id-ID, falling back to English. Report age labels still come from the Rust core in English; the UI and CSV map them by bucket position. Verified with npm run verify (118 Rust tests) and regenerated screenshots.

tasks.title: Localization plumbing
tasks.notes: Follow-up to I18N, closing the gaps a review found around the translation rather than in it. PDF money, dates and percentage labels now follow pdf.locale (Rp1.234,56, 7,50%, Indonesian month abbreviations, NPWP); the reminder email uses the document language too. The lock gate paints in the cached ui.locale before the database is readable, and Settings > Appearance names the selected language in its own words. Number inputs accept comma decimals under the Indonesian locale for quantities, discounts and tax rates. Backend errors are mapped to errors.* in src/lib/errors.ts at the IPC boundary, so every existing String(e) handler shows the app language while unknown messages still fall through in English. Deliberately unchanged at the time: per-record document language (done later, see DOC-LOCALE), the UTC date shift, and placeholder-parity checks (see the review notes). Verified with npm run verify.

tasks.title: Per-document language
tasks.notes: Delivers PRD FR-SET-6. client, invoice and estimate each gain a nullable locale; NULL means inherit, so an old document keeps following its client until someone fixes a language on it rather than freezing a resolved value at save time. PDF export resolves invoice/estimate, then client, then Settings > Invoicing; a statement follows its client only; the invoice reminder email follows the same chain in the UI. Chosen in the document's Details card and in the client's Billing section, with the inherit option naming the fallback. Migration 0012_document_locale.sql; the MCP server needs no change because its input field defaults to inherit. Verified with npm run verify (122 Rust tests) and regenerated screenshots.

tasks.title: Due-date notifications
tasks.notes: Shipped with TRAY. src-tauri/src/reminders.rs counts issued, unpaid, past-due invoices (drafts, void and not-yet-due are excluded), gates on one local date via notify.lastRun, and sends a single notification carrying only a count -- never a name, amount or invoice number. Checks run after launch (deferred while locked), on unlock, at the next local midnight (one rescheduled sleep, not a poll) and when the window is shown. Uses tauri-plugin-notification from Rust only, so the webview is granted no notification permission; the permission state is surfaced in Settings > Appearance. Tests cover the query, the date gate, the copy and the defaults.

tasks.title: European e-invoicing (EN 16931 / Peppol)
tasks.notes: Researched 2026-10-17; findings and sources in docs/EINVOICING.md. ViDA (adopted 2025-03-11) makes structured intra-EU B2B e-invoicing the default from 2030-07-01, and Germany, Belgium, Poland, France and Italy already mandate it domestically. The mandate is about *transmission* over Peppol access points or national platforms, which is network and would break the offline promise; what is compatible is generating and locally validating the file for the user to hand over. The prerequisites are data-model, not XML: a VAT category code on tax rates (BT-151), UN/ECE Rec 20 unit codes, country-prefixed VAT IDs, an EndpointID with an EAS scheme, a buyer or order reference (BT-10) and bank details (BT-84). Phase 1 would be Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 UBL export; Phase 2 Factur-X PDF/A-3. Revisit on a real need to send, not on a date.
